user.title: Devices to export
user.description: Your Energy dashboard tracks {nombre} device(s). Which ones should the file include? Their names are never exported: only a category (voiture_1, pac_1...).

data_description.conservation_ans: Fine-resolution recordings stay inside Home Assistant (finished months compressed). Older months are deleted.
data_description.pas_5min: Off by default. Keeps 5-minute periods instead of quarter-hours (about 2.5 times more storage): starts and cycles make devices easier to recognise. Exports can then be made at 5 or 15 minutes.

selection.title: Selection
selection.description: Devices are listed from the most to the least useful for the analysis: large and controllable loads (car, heat pump, hot water), then cooking and washing, then base load (cold, IT, lighting, ventilation, pumps). Recommended ones are ticked; you remain free to choose.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Choose each device's category (suggested from its name, its Home Assistant device and its typical power).

abort.tableau_energie_vide: Set up the Energy dashboard first (grid, solar or battery).

envoi.title: Send to analyse.sbg-energy.com

data_description.envoi_actif: Ticking it starts the connection to your SBG Energy account: a code to enter on auth.sbg-energy.com. No password is stored in Home Assistant.
data_description.code_postal: Required to send (Home Assistant does not know it). Used for grid tariffs, region and the area's weather, never for an address. Can also be changed in your account.
data_description.grd: The company that runs your meter (shown on your bill). Used for grid tariffs. "I don't know": the service infers it from your postcode when only one operator is possible, or keeps the one given on your home's page.
data_description.ameliorer_outils: Optional, unticked by default. "I agree that SBG keeps my consumption data, pseudonymised, to improve its tools (simulator, SBG Home). I can withdraw this consent at any time." Only if ticked: each month received is used, 90 days later, for postcode statistics (monthly totals without name, published from 10 households) and a pseudonymised copy. Unticking erases the copies; totals already given, anonymous, can no longer be traced.
data_description.logement: The home of your SBG Energy account that receives this installation's data. Choosing another moves this source there.
data_description.pas_envoi: 5 only with the "finest step: 5 minutes" option.
data_description.deconnecter: Forgets the connection here and withdraws it at SBG Energy; nothing is sent anymore.

connexion.title: Connect your SBG Energy account
connexion.description: Open {url} and enter the code **{code}**, then sign in to your SBG Energy account (with your 6-digit code) and accept. This screen closes by itself (10 minutes at most).

logement.title: Your home
logement.description: This installation's data join the home **{logement}** of your SBG Energy account: its report will use them. If your account has several homes, you can choose another one below; you can also move this source later, here or from the home's page.

data_description.logement: The home of your SBG Energy account that receives this installation's data. Choosing another moves this source there.

progress.connexion: Open {url} and enter the code **{code}**. Waiting for your approval…

abort.auth_injoignable: auth.sbg-energy.com cannot be reached: nothing was enabled. Try again later.
abort.connexion_echouee: Connection not completed: {message} Nothing was enabled.
abort.reglages_refuses: Sending not enabled: {message} The token was forgotten and withdrawn.

error.pas_5_sans_option: The 5-minute step needs the "finest step: 5 minutes" option.
error.code_postal: A 4-digit Belgian postcode is required to send.
error.installation_effacee: This installation's data were deleted from your SBG Energy account: sending is off and no longer retries. To resume it, first allow this installation again from your account, then tick "Send to analyse.sbg-energy.com".

options.pompe: Pumps and water (tank, pool, UV, softener)

exporter.name: Export
exporter.description: Writes the "SBG HA export" file (past data hourly, quarter-hours or 5-minute periods where recorded) and notifies a local download link. Nothing is sent anywhere.

pas.name: Step (minutes)
pas.description: 5 (only with the "finest step: 5 minutes" option), 15 or 60.

debut.name: Start
debut.description: First day (UTC). Default: start of statistics.

fin.name: End
fin.description: End day, excluded (UTC). Default: current hour.

envoyer.name: Send now
envoyer.description: Sends the missing days to analyse.sbg-energy.com (only if sending is enabled and your account connected). The service accepts one send per month.

reimporter.name: Re-import a period
reimporter.description: Sends the chosen days again and REPLACES them at analyse.sbg-energy.com (3 times per month at most).
